text:
maria-eng: Heads-up — EU staging is showing sporadic SDK v3.2 signature mismatches right after the canary. Not widespread but enough to flag.

sam-plat: saw the alerts. stacktrace points to headers parsing in sdk runtime shim. Could be a serialization change in 3.2.

irina-qa: Repro steps? I can run targeted smoke across eu-west-1 and eu-central-1.

maria-eng: repro on a small sample: start a chat with content-type application/json; sdk returns 400 with `invalid_signature` for streamed responses >1kb.

kev-release: Deploybot: can we freeze runtime upgrades in EU regions while we triage? /deploybot pin region=eu runtime=2.14 reason="sdk-3.2-serial-mismatch"

deploybot: @kev-release acknowledged. Pin applied: runtime=2.14 locked in eu-west-1, eu-central-1. No new runtime upgrades will be routed to those regions. (action_id=pb-4821)

jon-prod: Good call. What's rollback criteria? We should codify a simple playbook in case user-facing errors spike.

maria-eng: Proposal — telemetry gate: if `invalid_signature` traces >0.25% of requests for 15m OR user error rate delta +0.5% relative to baseline => auto rollback to prior routing and start full rollback runbook.

irina-qa: I'll run a focused regression suite and smoke for streaming >1kb. ETA ~20m. Also will test the old SDK v3.1 to ensure it works end-to-end.

sam-plat: I'll check the gateway/parsing shim; preliminary find: header canonicalization changed in sdk 3.2 during chunked streaming. Quick fix might be to normalize header casing in shim.

kev-release: We'll update the release notes and change window: add a note "EU: runtime upgrades temporarily held due to SDK 3.2 streaming incompatibility" and push to release-notes/docs/private-changes. Also bump the canary hold in the release calendar for 2 hours.

deploybot: Deploy freeze in effect for EU regions until 1713463600 UTC or until manual lift by @kev-release.

jon-prod: Action items: (1) irina run QA smoke + post results, (2) sam try a shim normalization patch and small hotfix build, (3) maria coordinate a rollback threshold alert and dashboard widget.

irina-qa: QA: streaming >1kb failure confirmed on sdk 3.2 in staging — reproducer attached (pasted snippet):
```
POST /v1/chat
Content-Type: application/json
{"messages": [{"role":"user","content":"A"*2000}]}
// response: 400 invalid_signature in mid-stream
```
sam-plat: I pushed a small patch to normalize header keys in the runtime shim — testing now in a micro-canary (eu-west-1-usermock).

maria-eng: If the micro-canary is green and irina's full suite passes, we can consider a controlled unpin for the specific runtime path with an ops guard (50% traffic for 10m then 100%).

kev-release: Agreed. If patch passes, do staged unpin: 50% -> 10m healthcheck -> 100%. Keep the pin for other runtime variants. Also note rollback trigger for the dashboard.

deploybot: micro-canary deploy started (deploy_id=pb-4821-2). Will post health metrics in #eng-runtime.

jon-prod: Thanks all. Keep messages concise in this thread; escalate to postmortem channel if we hit rollback. :thumbsup:
